services.desc: Paddle with us! 1, 2, 4, & 8 hour options About We are the oldest jet ski rental company on Lake Minnetonka operating for 23 years. We are a small, family run business, and we are now the only rental outfit with a beach front, park, and picnic location. We are offering not only new, four stroke personal watercraft (jet skis), but also paddle boards and kayaks. quotes.text: Had a great experience with these guys. They accommodated a relatively late notice reservation (24 hours in advance), were very thorough but chill, and when my kiddo got sore and fatigued half way into our 2 hr rental, they even refunded me for our unused hour. They sure didn't have to (we already signed and paid) but it was very much appreciated. We'll be back next summer for sure.

Wow!! Ken and Sean made our first time jet ski rental a breeze! They were my first call for a week rental they were so accommodating and easy to work with. Look no further and rent one of these what a blast machines. You will receive top notch service,impeccable machines,a great sense of humor and a ton of fun! Can't wait to rent again~

My husband and I rented a jet ski from Bay Rentals and it was so much fun. Ken was very helpful and funny, he gave us a map and showed us a good route around the lakes. All of the staff was very friendly. The jet ski was fairly new and worked perfectly for the two of us! We will definitely be back again!

Amazing experience. The whole Bay Rental team was great. Rented 2 machines for a family reunion on the Lake. The machines were in great condition and ran flawlessly. They were the highlight of the weekend. I would strongly recommend Bay Rental!
Great experience at Bay Rentals! We rented one jet ski for 2 hours and it was perfect. Helpful staff, beautiful location, and reasonable prices. Highly recommend!
We had such an AMAZING experience today! Not only did we have so much fun, the staff were also accommodating and very informative. Cannot wait to do it again!!
